about: Rider & bike studio v3 catalogue: every shop slot of the research outline, swappable and visible. Presentation only: shapes, patterns, colours. Nothing here enters physics, drafting or results. Makers are invented; specs and eras are real-world descriptions. Prices are Batzen tiers; earned items carry an unlock and no price. Colours, widths, depths, lengths, heights, counts and lens categories are free on any owned item.

rules.priceTheIdea: A shape, pattern or era is sold; widths, depths, lengths, heights, counts, sizes, lens categories and colours are free on any owned item.
conflicts: A full frame bag leaves no room for bottles; a half frame bag leaves room for one.
Frame bags never on TT, hour or track frames.
The TT visor replaces the glasses while worn.
Knickers and tights already cover the knee: knee and leg warmers hide.
Long sleeves already cover the arm: arm warmers hide.
A rain or winter jacket brings its own long sleeves.
Delta brakes need rim brakes; electronic and down-tube shifting need a derailleur.
Chrome lugs need a steel frame; raw weave needs carbon.
Tyre width is clamped to the frame’s clearance.
Gipfelpunkte never puts dots on a white ground: a light main colour swaps with the dots.
rules.sound: Hub voices play only in the wearer’s own mix, on the cues fader, synthesised.
rules.light: No item is emissive or blinks; screens are dark glass (ADR-0072).

items.blurb: Sits you low; changes nothing else.

items.blurb: One hour, one gear, one line on the track. On the trainer: the same hour as everyone.

items.blurb: Earned by riding 200 rides; never sold.

items.name: Dickrohr

items.blurb: Fat tubes, loud paint, the decade the brake levers learned to shift.

items.name: Muffe 03
items.spec: Carbon tubes bonded into alloy lugs, compact geometry, 10-speed
items.blurb: The first carbon bike most of your club owned.

items.name: Randonneur
items.spec: Lugged steel, 650B wheels, fenders, front rack, dynamo lamp (unlit)
items.blurb: Paris to the next valley and back, with a baguette in the front bag.

items.name: Bahnrad
items.spec: Track geometry, one fixed gear, no brakes
items.blurb: On a trainer it still freewheels when your data says so.

items.name: Ordonnanzrad 05
items.spec: Black steel, one gear, coaster brake, fenders, frame bag and rack; the real one weighed 22.5 kg
items.blurb: The army bicycle, built for 83 years. Nothing here changes speed, not even 22.5 kg of steel.
